summary: Verified Hoja de entrada server-side PDF (WeasyPrint) end-to-end. Backend endpoint returns 200 application/pdf (%PDF header) for valid id and 404 for invalid id. Frontend: dropdown 'Hoja de entrada' from Órdenes de trabajo AND 'Imprimir hoja y finalizar' from Recepción rápida both call window.open with the correct URL /api/taller/ordenes/{id}/hoja-entrada.pdf, target=_blank.
critical_code_review_comments: OrdenesTrabajo.jsx had stray duplicated JSX after final } (lines 405-413) causing 'Unexpected token (409:19)' compile error and breaking the entire frontend. Fixed by removing garbage tail. Main agent should ensure editor/patcher doesn't append duplicates on save.
seed_data_creation: Created OT-000021 with matrícula TEST1234 via Recepción rápida during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoint /api/taller/ordenes/{oid}/hoja-entrada.pdf verified returning valid PDF (>1KB, %PDF header). Frontend window.open interception confirmed both call sites (OrdenesTrabajo dropdown item hoja-entrada-{id} at line 73 and RecepcionRapida rr-imprimir-finalizar at line 76) use hojaEntradaUrl() with target=_blank. NOTE: had to fix a compile-blocking syntax error (leftover duplicate JSX tail) in OrdenesTrabajo.jsx before frontend could load.
rca of the issue: Bug FIXED. WeasyPrint server-side PDF replaces the previous iframe/HTML print approach. Backend generates real A4 landscape PDF (23KB+). Both frontend triggers open this PDF URL in a new tab so the browser uses its native PDF viewer (no compressed/deformed layout). Prior compile error from stray JSX in OrdenesTrabajo.jsx was blocking the fix from being visible in the UI; removed during testing.
